sentences.en: For how long will I continue to have these symptoms?
sentences.zh: 这些症状还会持续多久？

sentences.en: You should consult a doctor if the symptoms get worse.
sentences.zh: 如果症状加重，你应该去看医生。

sentences.en: Being on time is a symptom of a boring life.
sentences.zh: 准时可能是生活乏味的一个征兆。

senses.zh: （医） 症状；（大问题的）迹象，征兆，征候
